Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

symcompR 0.1.0

  • First version: a native R port of SymPy (pinned to commit 86150a81), with no Python dependency. It covers 867 of the 901 names in SymPy’s top level API: core arithmetic and assumptions, elementary and special functions, calculus, integration and integral transforms, polynomials, algebraic number theory and Galois groups, simplification, solvers (algebraic, inequalities, ODE, PDE, recurrences, Diophantine), matrices and matrix expressions, number theory, combinatorics and group theory, logic, sets, geometry, statistics, sequences and Fourier series, vectors, tensors, physical units, parsers (SymPy, LaTeX and Mathematica syntax), and printers (LaTeX, MathML, two dimensional text, and code in thirteen languages).
  • Attaching the package masks no base R function. SymPy names that clash with base R carry a sym_ prefix (sym_factor(), sym_integrate(), sym_prod(), sym_reshape(), …) or are S3 methods of the base generic.
  • Machine readable citation and software metadata: CITATION.cff, codemeta.json, .zenodo.json, ro-crate-metadata.json, and inst/CITATION.

Developed by Adam R Sophie.
